answer: Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 272 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the hollow funding graph is rebuilt from the nectar history every epoch. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 272 bonds yet holds one position, and the yarrow report publishes the merged exposure. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
